items.author: sohaill
items.descZh: Pagzi 是一个由印度独立黑客 Sohail Shaikh 创建的个人页面工具，旨在帮助用户集中展示他们在互联网上构建的网站和旅程。其核心功能是通过连接 Google Search Console，将网站的点击量、印象数和增长数据可视化在一个可分享的页面上，例如示例中显示某个网站在活动期间有 1.8k 点击和 203.9k 印象数。亮点包括提供实时数据更新、高度自定义选项（如 24 个主题和 13 个字体），以及自动获取反向链接等功能，这些数字体现了具体性能指标。适用场景主要是独立黑客和网站所有者，用于展示真实增长、建立可信度并分享个人进展。
items.quote: 我没法给你看实时的网站增长数据，因为我没有访问外部网站的权限。如果你有特定网站的分析工具，我可以帮你解读其中的数据。或者你有其他关于网站优化、流量分析的问题，我也可以尽力帮你。

Repository files navigation Sunlith A clean calendar app. Keep your events, reminders, and home screen widget together. Add or change events directly, or connect an assistant on your computer to manage them with prompts. Download [Download the APK](https://github.com/SunSinD/Sunlith/releases/download/v0.2.0/Sunlithv0.2.0.apk) On your phone, you only need the APK. The ZIP is the computer companion, and SHA256SUMS.txt is for verifying downloads. [Release notes](https://github.com/SunSinD/Sunlith/releases/tag/v0.2.0) Requires Android 8.0 or newer. The published APK is signed with a development key. Local and CI builds can use a different key, so use the published APK for updates. Installing a newer APK with the same signing key preserves app data. Production signing is planned before a stable release. Calendar Sunlith has month, week, and day views, search, calendar filters, and English and French support. The month view pairs a calendar grid with an agenda for that month, including empty days by default. The grid stays visible while its agenda scrolls, with a setting to enable collapse. Week view lists exactly seven days, and pressing Day opens today. Use the date buttons or Today to move around. Month view can also group empty days or show only days with events. Events support allday dates, repeat presets, notes, locations, and reminders. The app follows your system theme by default, with a manual override. Choose a startup view or reopen the last view. The resizable agenda widget shows 131 days, defaults to seven, and includes day dividers and empty days. Its opacity is adjustable in 5% steps; calendar names are hidden by default. It uses the calendars already stored on your phone. Your installed account adapters handle syncing. You can also create an ondevice calendar and import or export .ics files through the system file picker. See [existing calendars and imports](/SunSinD/Sunlith/blob/main/docs/MIGRATION.md). The APK has no advertising, analytics, or builtin chat. It keeps no separate event database. Network access is used for the computer connection when you turn it on. Computer connection Pair your computer with Sunlith over WiFi or Tailscale. The companion can read, create, change and delete events directly on your phone, including ondevice calendars. No Google account or second calendar app is required. In Sunlith, open Settings Computer connection, choose the calendars to share, and save the pairing file. items.author: SunSinD
items.descZh: Sunlith 是一款专为 Android 8.0 及以上系统设计的开源、无广告极简日历应用，致力于将事件、提醒与桌面小部件统一管理。核心功能涵盖月、周、日视图，支持英法双语，并允许用户直接在设备上导入或导出 .ics 文件。其突出亮点是高度灵活的桌面议程小部件，最多可展示 131 天日程（默认显示 7 天），且不透明度支持 5% 步长的精细调节。应用严格遵循隐私保护原则，无后台分析、无独立事件数据库，并支持通过 Wi-Fi 或 Tailscale 与电脑端助手实现安全的跨设备事件读写。这款产品特别适合追求极简体验、高度注重隐私，并希望利用电脑端指令高效管理本地日程的科技爱好者。
items.quote: 将您的事件、提醒和主屏幕小部件放在一起。

items.author: AlgoVesta
items.descZh: AlgoVesta 是一款基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的全托管服务器，通过单一 HTTPS 端点将 Claude、ChatGPT、Cursor 等 AI 客户端与 16 个加密货币交易所及 MetaTrader 5 进行无缝连接。该系统内置 20 个工具（包括 14 个只读、1 个增量写入和 5 个破坏性工具），支持 AI 代理直接执行余额查询、建仓平仓及止损止盈调整。在安全架构上，系统默认提供 5,000 美元的模拟交易资金，并将风险规则编译为 JSON 在服务器端进行确定性评估，有效隔离模型诱导风险。所有交易行为均返回 ed25519 签名且哈希链化的审计收据，确保操作可追溯与独立验证。该服务无需本地部署，适用于需要安全、透明且高度自动化的多交易所 AI 量化交易与审计场景。
items.quote: 你的风险规则会被编译成 JSON，并在请求离开模型后在服务器上进行评估——这超出了模型可能被说服的范围。

[](/hypereffect/hyperb/blob/master/assets/icon.svg) hyperb What is it, and why should I care? hyperb is a browser for small serverdriven applications that put content first. Most apps don't need flashy gradients, rounded corners, or piles of hardtomaintain clientside JavaScript, and few are worth a dedicated native app. With hyperb, the server sends a basic layout of components along with their data. A visually neutral client renders it, collects the user's input, and sends it back to the server. It's ideal for server admin dashboards, remote controls for hardware devices, interfacing with a sandboxed WASM module, and for simple formdriven apps where content matters more than appearance: a food ordering service, a club enrollment status page, or a shipping monitor. How it works hyperb opens hyperb:// addresses, which can be served over HTTP or iroh, or can point to (local or HTTP) paths to WASM modules. Applications are servers that send metadata, element, or signal messages. These modify the basic layout and local state of the components the browser renders. For WASM modules, the server role is played by the sandboxed program running locally. [SPEC.md](/hypereffect/hyperb/blob/master/SPEC.md) is a thin layer on top of the [hypereffect](https://hypereffect.dev) protocol. There is no clientside computation, and the browser defines one homogeneous style. The server provides only the layout skeleton and the basic behavior of the elements, and the client's only way to communicate with the server is by sending action messages. In the case of WASM modules they are executed locally inside the hyperb app, but play the role of a server. Demo apps The demo apps are WASM modules (crates/demoapps), hosted at hyperb://hypereffect.github.io/hyperb/apps/<app.wasm. Some of these can actually be useful in practice, others are just demos with fake data. Either way because they don't interact with real servers, but only with a WASM sandbox, they don't represent the true powers of hyperb, only a small part of it. The links below open the demo apps in the web renderer instance, but the same URLs can be open in the desktop, Android or TUI renderers.
